RoHelper 0.9.0

Export all or selected saved account sessions to a local file.
Bulk-import session files or pasted batches with verified Roblox identities and a review before saving.
Detect repeated sessions and duplicate Roblox account IDs; keep existing saved logins unless replacement is selected.
Preserve inventories, progress, tags and account customization, with protected rollback/recovery for import saves.
Source snapshots are hosted separately in rohelper-source.
